Method of Attack: Discord token stealer, Credit card stealer (Windows-based)
Discoverer: Andrey Polkovnichenko, Omer Kaspi and Shachar Menashe at JFrog
Indicators of Compromise: Base64-encoded Python code passed to eval(), Discord tokens stolen, web-browser files storing credit card numbers stolen, screenshot capturing, Windows version and license key info, IP address, computer name/user name uploaded to Discord Webhook
Additional Notes: Packages use simple obfuscation; aryi and suffer obfuscated using PyArmor; noblesse family falsely advertises as optimization packages
